# CodexMeter 1.0.6
CodexMeter 1.0.6 corrects local token totals on macOS and Windows.
## Fixes
- Local Total now uses `Input + Output`. - Cached Input remains visible as the portion of Input served from cache, but is no longer added to Total a second time. - Today, This Week, This Month, and Local History are recalculated from the existing component data without a database migration. - Settings, tooltips, architecture documentation, and Windows installation links now describe the corrected accounting semantics.
Account-wide ChatGPT profile totals remain separate and unchanged.
## Integrity and platform trust
These packages are distributed without Apple Developer ID, Apple notarization, or a Microsoft publisher certificate. Verify the official SHA-256 manifest before bypassing Gatekeeper or SmartScreen. The macOS automatic-update feed and ZIP archive are separately authenticated with Sparkle Ed25519 signatures.
## macOS with Homebrew
```bash brew update brew upgrade --cask codexmeter xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/CodexMeter.app open /Applications/CodexMeter.app ```
Fresh installations can use `brew install --cask HechoLP/tap/codexmeter`.
## Windows portable download
Download the x64 or ARM64 ZIP together with `SHA256SUMS-windows.txt`, compare the PowerShell `Get-FileHash` result with the manifest, and extract the verified package to a permanent folder.
